caption: The drawing depicts a single gray ceramic vessel with a rounded belly, a wide open mouth, and a short spout projecting from its side. The vessel has a metal or wire handle attached to loops near the opening, with faint blue-gray marks at the attachment points and on the lower body. The inside of the vessel is shaded brown, indicating depth. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a rectangular label with a blue border, featuring the uppercase text "WHITE'S BINGHAMTON" above the number "4". The background is plain and off-white, with minimal shadow or detailing, and there is a faint, small scale bar below the pot.
